title: Uniqueness from Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f$ and $g$ be real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. If their Fourier coefficients agree for every subset of the coordinate set, then $f=g$.
